create_visualization_geometries: create open3d geometries for a point cloud with optional origin, arrow, sphere, and grasp indicators
show_point_cloud: show a point cloud from xyz and rgb numpy arrays with optional grasp poses and save to image
save_geometries_as_image: save open3d geometries as an image with configurable camera extrinsic, zoom, and clipping parameters
opengl_depth_to_xyz: convert an OpenGL depth image to world XYZ coordinates using a pinhole camera model and correction rotation
add_additive_noise_to_xyz: add approximate Gaussian Process noise to an ordered point cloud for depth data augmentation
